column3: Twenty one days to form a habit? That number is basically a myth.
It comes from a 1960 self help book. A plastic surgeon wrote that it takes a minimum of about twenty one days for a person's self image to change.
When researchers in London actually tracked people building one simple habit, the middle point was sixty six days.
Some got there in eighteen. For others, the estimate stretched to two hundred and fifty four.
So if you're three weeks in and it still feels hard, you're not failing. Do it like Sung Jinwoo's daily quest. Keep showing up.
